name: dsh-ticktick
description: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge for DSH: a session-header task panel with filtering, search and drag reordering, eleven curated agent tools and a settings card, over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
longDescription: DSH 的滴答清单任务桥：会话头部任务面板（筛选 / 搜索 / 拖拽排序）、十一个代理工具与设置卡片，走官方 TickTick MCP 端点。
